label: late copy phase (absolute step >= 11), strongest on final outputs of long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L); never on original tokens, the <DEL> step, or the first copy output. Rate climbs with absolute step t: ~1% for t<=9, 19% at t=11, 44-50% at t=16-17 (the last two outputs of L=9 sequences), and L=9 holds 55% of mass. Top activations are on the final 1-2 outputs of 9-token sequences. A small secondary bump sits at recall_idx 2 (t=L+2) in short sequences (L=3..5). Predicate captures ~89% of active steps and ~92% of mass, but precision is only ~0.22: within the late copy phase which steps fire depends on sequence content in a way no single token variable captured (out_tok/prev_tok lifts are mild and token-set filters did not help).
